title: GitHub via gh
description: How GitHub is managed from this project: through the gh CLI only, with risky commands blocked or confirmed. The gh account itself is checked by identity rule ID005.
applies_to: curl / wget / Invoke-WebRequest / Invoke-RestMethod to api.github.com

rules.name: use-gh-for-api
rules.title: Call the GitHub API through gh
rules.description: Direct HTTP calls to api.github.com (curl, wget, Invoke-WebRequest, Invoke-RestMethod, irm, iwr) are blocked; use gh api so the checked gh account is used.

rules.name: command-policy
rules.title: Risky gh commands are blocked or confirmed
rules.description: Each entry matches a gh command prefix (e.g. 'repo delete'). 'deny' blocks it, 'ask' asks you to confirm. The first matching entry wins.

commands.reason: Deleting a repository is irreversible; do it yourself in the browser.
Renaming changes the remote URL for everyone.
Repository settings change (visibility, default branch, features).
Transferring ownership is not allowed from the agent.
Would print a secret token into the transcript.
Moves an issue to another repository.

rules.name: api-mutation
rules.title: Mutating gh api calls need confirmation
rules.description: gh api with -X/--method other than GET, or with -f/-F/--field/--raw-field/--input (which imply POST), uses this rule's severity. DELETE uses delete_severity.

rules.name: pr-noninteractive
rules.title: gh pr create must not prompt
rules.description: gh pr create must pass --title and one of --body / --body-file / --fill / --fill-first / --fill-verbose / --template, so it never opens an interactive prompt.

rules.name: pr-title-convention
rules.title: PR titles follow the commit header convention
rules.description: --title on gh pr create / gh pr edit is checked with the header rules of the commit-message contract (CM003-CM010, CM014). Errors use this rule's severity.

rules.name: repo-owner-scope
rules.title: Target repositories belong to an allowed owner
rules.description: An explicit repository (-R/--repo owner/name, the OWNER/REPO argument of gh repo clone/view/create/fork/sync, or a repos/OWNER/... gh api path) whose owner is not in allowed_owners uses this rule's severity. Skipped when allowed_owners resolves to an empty list (no github_user / github_orgs in the profile).

bad: gh issue create -R someone-else/x --title t --body b

rules.name: repo-create-visibility
rules.title: gh repo create states its visibility
rules.description: gh repo create must pass --private, --public or --internal. --public uses public_severity.

rules.name: pr-body-sections
rules.title: PR bodies have summary, detailed changes, explanation and local test results
rules.description: The body of gh pr create (and of gh pr edit when it sets one) must contain a markdown heading matching each entry of 'sections', each with real content under it (not empty, not only placeholders or HTML comments). A section's 'must_mention' words must appear in its content, so the test section reports both unit tests and lint. A body that cannot be read (--fill, --web, --template, shell variables) uses unreadable_severity.
